title: Terry Funk’s attack turns Flair into the defender
summary: Terry Funk responds violently when Ric Flair refuses his championship challenge. Flair becomes the target of a personal vendetta that grows into a wider battle involving Sting, Muta and Gary Hart.

chapters.title: Funk attacks the new champion
chapters.result: Funk piledrives Flair onto a table after Flair’s title victory.
chapters.context: The rejected challenge changes a night of sporting respect into the start of a violent grudge.

chapters.title: Flair makes Funk quit
chapters.result: Flair defeats Funk in an I Quit match.
chapters.context: Forcing a verbal surrender delivers a direct resolution to the personal conflict.
